**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/17 (Fri) 03:49  
[USER] User requested the design of a file sync service for uploading files to the cloud and syncing across devices.  
[USER] User asked for creativity and detailed product features, constraints, and requirements.  
[FACT] Core Requirements: Sync all files across all devices, max file size of 4GB, efficient and resumable uploads/downloads, critical user bandwidth efficiency.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Core Requirements: Sync all the files across all the devices of the user, a file could be at max 4GB big, the upload and downloads should be efficient and resumable, user's bandwidth is critical, so be efficient.  
[FACT] High-Level Requirements: High availability, data durability, scalability, cost-effectiveness, interoperability with other services.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] High-Level Requirements: Make high-level components operate with high availability, ensure data durability, define system behavior while scaling, make system cost-effective, describe service interactions.  
[FACT] Micro Requirements: Data consistency, deadlock-free system, throughput not affected by locking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Micro Requirements: Ensure data in the system is never in an inconsistent state, ensure the system is free of deadlocks, ensure throughput is not affected by locking.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Design Document: The system will use a client-server architecture with a distributed file system for high availability and scalability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The server will be implemented using a distributed file system, such as HDFS.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Clients will use a sync algorithm, such as rsync, to efficiently synchronize files with the server.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The sync algorithm will handle large files (up to 4GB) and support resumable transfers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Clients will cache frequently accessed files locally to reduce server load and improve bandwidth utilization.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To ensure data durability, the server will store multiple copies of each file using a replication factor.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The replication factor can be adjusted based on desired durability and storage cost.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The system will use a distributed lock manager, such as Zookeeper, to coordinate updates and prevent concurrent updates.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The lock manager will ensure all updates are applied in the correct order.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To ensure the system is deadlock-free, a hierarchical locking scheme will be used.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The system will use a load balancer, such as HAProxy, to distribute load and improve throughput.
